column1: # Dates from ICU4C 78.3 (CLDR 48) at noon UTC in the Gregorian calendar: DateFormat
# date formats and the best pattern DateTimePatternGenerator gives a date skeleton,
# on the 21st of each month of 2024. aa is left out because ICU4C carries no aa
# data. Non-ASCII characters are written as \u{hex}.
# Columns: mode (date, date_skeleton), locale, style or skeleton, year, month and
# day, the formatted string, and for a skeleton ICU's pattern.
